comparison.objective: Hand-pollinate two female cucumber flowers in the correct transfer sequence; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Manipulate a light brush tip through millimetre-scale strokes, first on anthers then stigmas, versus hex-bit insertion, torque, collar rotation, and guarded testing.
comparison.success_condition: A pollen-loaded brush must make ≥5 mm strokes within the stated 4 mm/1 mm contact region on both females; candidate requires two safe compliant impact cycles and no setting drift.
comparison.reason: Although both demand fine tool-tip control and sequencing, pollen transfer and damper calibration test different physical outcomes.
